verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a chat-based AI Assistant that lets users plan, prioritize, and optimize their schedule in natural language. Its 2.0 Schedule Assistant acts as a control center that suggests next actions and previews calendar changes before deploying them. A live first-party MCP endpoint with read/write scopes also suggests external agents could drive it conversationally, though that server is undocumented. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which commands or actions the assistant can execute, hands-on or community corroboration of natural-language operation, and official documentation of the MCP server.
